newsitem.title: USA: TABLE-Intermedia sells $350 mln in junk bonds.
newsitem.headline: TABLE-Intermedia sells $350 mln in junk bonds.

text.p: The following 144a private placement from Intermedia Communications Inc was priced on Thursday via lead manager Bear Stearns & Co Inc, according to market sources.

The $350 million (proceeds) offering was increased from an original size of $300 million. The company simultaneously sold six million shares of $25 junior convertible preferred stock (CAA/CCC) yielding seven percent in a 144a private placement.
